text: Welcome to the website of Marinov & Partner Steuerberater! We focus on consulting for international employees (mostly expatriates) as well as for their employers. We have big international groups among our clients but also small and medium-sized German and foreign companies with cross-border activities. The main purpose of our advice is to optimize the client's tax and social security situation in all countries involved. The full avoidance of double taxation is our primary objective. The partners Emil and Nadine Marinov have been working at the Frankfurt department for expatriate taxation of a Big Four company for several years. We advise clients in many countries all over the world. We enjoy working in person with people from different countries and nations which is the most important piece of our philosophy. Give us a call! Send us an e-mail! We provide quick, straightforward and reliable assistance. Our experts are fluent in German and Bulgarian. Ottawa, Canada Practice Our practice is organized specifically for working with international clients. We strictly follow our high quality standards to exceed client expectations. We work hard on optimizing our work processes and streamlining the practice in order to let our clients benefit from lower costs. We run a paperless electronic office which enables us and our clients to get access to tax documents and information any time and any place. By using all modern channels we make sure that we communicate efficiently with our clients around the world E-mail availability around the clock Telephone and video conferences Data transfer via FTP We work with tailored checklists to collect information from our clients in a most efficient way. But we set high value on the personal coordination with the client. We continuously improve our tax skills in international taxation and other areas. By attending workgroups and staying in touch with professional associations and the tax administration we keep ourselves up to date on current legislative procedures. We conduct tax presentations and distribute newsletters to our clients on current topics and developments in German tax law. Ottawa, Canada Philosophy We want to contribute to your success with our quality service. We measure the quality of our service with your satisfaction and success. The partners and their team have developed a strong service orientation during the years of work with foreign consultants and clients which are service providers in other competitive sectors. We see ourselves primarily as a service provider and seek to impress our clients with excellent service. Our advisors have long experience in international taxation and will support you to find local and global solutions. Working close with you We spend as much time as needed to understand your situation in order to offer you services tailored to your needs. We always prefer the direct and straight-forward communication and meeting/talking our clients in person. We meet our clients at their premises if they prefer. We offer bring and collect service for documents on demand. Single point of contact You communicate with one and the same consultant at any time. You do not have to deal with changing contacts. Quick Processing We work hard to finish each project as quickly as possible and reach the expected results. Even if we cannot meet a very short deadline, we seek alternative solutions based on our client's schedule. Transparent work We keep our clients posted at any stage of the work. Our communication efficiency and modern IT systems make this possible without causing additional fees for the client. International clients We advise clients from many countries and are familiar with the questions that arise in cross-border situations. Individual Fees We adapt our fees to the individual scope of service for each client. We communicate and discuss with the client openly our fee and invoicing conditions from the very beginning to avoid later misunderstandings and "surprises" for both sides. When invoicing we stick strictly to the agreed fees. We practice immediate invoicing. Tax news from Germany The latest reports from Haufe (in German), updated daily.

Fees Separate Services (e.g. personal income tax return) We calculate our fees according to the official German Schedule of Fees for Tax Advisors (StBGebV) which provides a fee range depending on the values involved. Based on this fee range we calculate the exact fee by taking into account the volume of work and our spent time. The better our clients prepare their documents and information, and the fewer clarifications are necessary, the lower our fees. Normally, we can give you a fee quote once we have received enough information about your tax situation during our first contact. If we find out later during the work that additional services will be required we immediately inform you upfront about the expected additional fees to get your approval. For repeating services like accounting and monthly payroll we are often able to offer fixed fees. Bundled Fees (e.g. full services for several expatriates) In deviation from the Schedule of Fees for Tax Advisors we offer fixed fees for service bundles which are lower than the sum of separate service fees. The bundled fee discount depends in particular on the scope of services and how many packages for how long we agree upon. Example We are engaged to provide the following tax services to a foreign expatriate by his German employer during the entire expatriation (3 years) an entrance meeting and application for German child allowances at the beginning of the expatriation 4 income tax returns during the stay in Germany an exit meeting at the end For such a full package we can offer a discount between 10% and 15% compared to the sum of all separate fees. If this package is negotiated for a higher number of expatriates we usually offer further discounts, sometimes up to 30% depending on the number of expatriates. Privacy policy This statement explains which personal data are processed when you visit this website and what rights you have. In short: the website does not set cookies, does not use analytics or advertising services and does not load content from third-party servers. 1. Controller Marinov & Partner Steuerberater Partners: StB Emil Marinov, StBin Nadine Marinov Meiereistraße 50 06847 Dessau-Roßlau Germany Phone: +49 340 661496-24 Fax: +49 340 661496-35 E-mail: info@steuerberater-marinov.de 2. Hosting (GitHub Pages) This website is hosted on GitHub Pages, a service of GitHub, Inc., 88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA. When you visit the website, GitHub processes the data that are technically necessary to deliver it, in particular your IP address, the date and time of the request and the page requested; your browser usually also transmits information about the browser and operating system. According to GitHub, the IP address of visitors to a GitHub Pages site is logged and stored for security purposes. GitHub decides how long these data are kept. We do not receive these logs and do not analyse them. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. Our legitimate interest is to provide the website securely and reliably. GitHub, Inc. is based in the USA. According to GitHub, it participates in the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework; for transfers to certified companies in the USA there is an adequacy decision of the European Commission (Art. 45 GDPR). For more information, see GitHub’s privacy statement. 3. No cookies, no analytics, no third-party content This website does not set cookies and does not use any analytics, tracking or advertising services. Fonts, program libraries and the map data for the globe are stored on the same server as the website. No connections to other providers, such as font services or content delivery networks, are made when you visit it. 4. Settings stored in your browser To remember your settings, the website stores a few items exclusively in your browser on your device: the colour scheme you chose (dark, light or match device) and the text size – in the browser’s local storage, once you change the setting, until you delete them; a note that you have already seen the camera move on the home page or have already visited other pages, so that you go straight to the globe when you return to the home page – in the browser’s session storage, which is deleted when you close the window or tab. These items are not transmitted to us or anyone else. You can delete them at any time in your browser settings. The legal basis is Section 25(2) no. 2 TDDDG (German Telecommunications Digital Services Data Protection Act), as the storage is necessary to display the website the way you requested. 5. Tax news from Haufe The reports under “Tax news from Germany” come from the public news feed of Haufe (haufe.de). An automated process at GitHub (GitHub Actions) retrieves them once a day and stores them as a file on the server of this website. Your browser therefore does not connect to Haufe when you visit our website. Only when you click on a report does the Haufe website open in a new window; Haufe’s privacy policy applies there. 6. Links to other websites The website contains links to other providers, for example to OpenStreetMap for directions and to authorities and chambers. Data are only transmitted to these providers when you click on a link. The respective providers are responsible for their content and data processing. 7. Contacting us by e-mail, phone or fax If you contact us by e-mail, phone or fax, we process the information you provide (such as your name, contact details and the content of your enquiry) in order to deal with your enquiry. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR where your enquiry relates to an engagement or its preparation, and otherwise Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (our legitimate interest in answering enquiries). We delete the data as soon as they are no longer needed for this purpose, unless statutory retention obligations apply. Data transmission over the internet, for example by e-mail, may have security gaps. You can therefore also send us information by other means, for example by phone. 8. Job applications If you apply for a job with us, for example by e-mail, we process your information to carry out the application procedure (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). If an employment relationship is established, we keep the documents for the employment relationship in accordance with the statutory provisions. Otherwise, we delete the application documents two months after notifying you of the rejection, unless other legitimate interests prevent this, such as a burden of proof in proceedings under the German General Equal Treatment Act (AGG). 9. Your rights You have the right of access (Art. 15 GDPR), rectification (Art. 16 GDPR), erasure (Art. 17 GDPR), restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR) and data portability (Art. 20 GDPR). If you have given consent, you can withdraw it at any time with effect for the future (Art. 7(3) GDPR). Simply contact us (see section 1). Right to object: Where we process data on the basis of Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, you may object at any time on grounds relating to your particular situation (Art. 21 GDPR). You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR). The authority responsible for us is: Landesbeauftragter für den Datenschutz Sachsen-Anhalt (State Commissioner for Data Protection of Saxony-Anhalt) Otto-von-Guericke-Straße 34a 39104 Magdeburg Germany datenschutz.sachsen-anhalt.de 10. No automated decision-making We do not use automated individual decision-making or profiling. 11. Changes We update this statement when the website or the law changes. Last updated: October 2026.
